sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 10 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPCX、SPY、ORCL、AVGO、QQQ。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • May CPI up 4.2% YoY, a three-year high: Headline was in line with expectations (+0.5% MoM), while core CPI was +0.2% MoM and +2.9% YoY, coming in below expectations; the energy component surged 23.5% YoY due to the Iran conflict. After the open, the market initially rallied on the “soft core” narrative, with SPY briefly reaching 738.38, near flat on the day, before getting sold off again around 10:15 — the fourth consecutive day of the “morning rally → pre-noon rug” script. As of 12:07 ET, SPY was 731.95 (-0.69%, intraday low 728.51), QQQ 701.38 (-0.92%, repeatedly battling around the 700 level), DIA -1.01%, and IWM +0.08%, bucking the trend and turning green.
  • Trump on Iran: “we're going to be attacking them very hard today”: Remarks around 11:50 triggered an instantaneous drop of roughly 0.4% in SPY within minutes, followed by a partial recovery, forming the most violent minute-level long wick of the day. Alongside community-tracked flight-path reports of B-52s taking off from Sigonella Air Base in Italy and turning off transponders, the Middle East situation remains on an escalation track. WTI strengthened, with USO +2.92%; the EIA weekly report showed commercial crude inventories plunging by 7.2 million barrels in one week.
  • ORCL earnings after the close tonight — the second domino in AI capex: Wall Street expects EPS of $1.96 and revenue of $19.1B (+20%), with the focus on whether the $553B RPO backlog can translate into accelerated OCI revenue. ORCL is currently 205.83, roughly flat, but the massive intraday swing from 198.2 to 212.3 shows that bulls and bears are already placing their bets.
  • SpaceX Nasdaq listing on Friday (6/12) draining liquidity: Priced at $135/share, valued at $1.77 trillion, raising $75B — the largest IPO in history, more than triple Alibaba’s. “The whole market is selling stocks to free up cash for SPCX” has become the community’s top narrative explaining this week’s decline; today’s 13:00 ET 10-year Treasury auction (not yet held as of publication) is expected to further divert liquidity.
  • USMCA confirmed not to be directly renewed on 7/1: Trump said he is “not looking to renew,” and USTR confirmed it will shift to annual reviews plus renegotiation. The community is spamming “CODE RED: TARIFF ALERT,” worried about a second wave of tariff-driven inflation. Another anomaly: gold crashed, with GLD -3.01%; the fact that “safe-haven assets aren’t safe” sparked panic. Bitcoin, however, rose against the trend (IBIT +0.74%).

社区氛围：“假V——地毯——又是假V”绞肉机连续第三个交易日炸毁了多头和空头。社区情绪已经从昨天的愤怒滑落到疲惫引发的恐慌——空头明显多于多头，但没人敢持仓。大量用户宣布休假，针对算法、Jane Street 和取消 PDT 规则的阴谋指控达到顶峰。整体基调是“混乱中看跌，对市场结构本身的信任崩溃”。

恐慌/贪婪程度：大约 25/100（深度恐惧）。 VIX逼近22，为4月初以来最高点；纳斯达克指数连续四个交易日盘中涨幅超过 2%； “每天损失数万人”之类的呼声充斥着董事会。但 QQQ 700 和 SPY 730 附近的支撑，以及“有人肯定会买 700”的肌肉记忆，表明这还不是投降级别的恐慌。

社区情绪与实际市场行为：评论部分感觉像是 -3% 的崩盘日，但 SPY 实际上仅为 -0.7%，比 ATH 低约 6.5%，而小盘股甚至变成了绿色。这种分歧源于WSB高杠杆的0DTE人群在两个方向上都收获了：在IV飙升至46-60%后，即使方向正确仍然亏损，使得感受到的损失远远大于指数的跌幅。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
